mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ds_clickhouse_connection (id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, name, url, username, cluster_name, password_cipher, password_nonce, password_key_version, password_masked_hint, enabled, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{username}, #{cluster}, #{passwordCipher}, #{passwordNonce}, #{passwordKeyVersion}, #{passwordMaskedHint}, #{enabled}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, name, url, username, cluster_name, password_cipher, password_nonce, password_key_version, password_masked_hint, enabled, revision, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM ds_clickhouse_connection WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
